data-flow.note: Plain assignment in OnAfterSetFieldsBilltoCustomer on Sales Header; runs for every creation path, not on the page.
Plain assignment in OnAfterAssignItemValues on Sales Line.
Header OnValidate calls UpdateSalesLinesByFieldNo; subscriber to OnUpdateSalesLineByChangedFieldName validates the line field when ChangedFieldNo is Collection Group.

data-flow.note: No opened article or repository symbol confirms the line-initialization event that copies header values to a new line; see unresolved.

subscriptions.purpose: Default Collection Group from the bill-to customer.
guards: Use the bill-to event, not the sell-to event: collection data follows the bill-to party
Plain assignment from the Customer record the event passes
Do not copy on the page

subscriptions.purpose: Default Product Line Code from the item.
guards: Declare only the parameters used, with the names the Sales Line publisher declares

subscriptions.purpose: Validate Sales Line Collection Group from the header when the header field changes.
guards: Act only when ChangedFieldNo = FieldNo("Collection Group")
Validate the line field; never ModifyAll
Spell the sales event with singular "Line"

subscriptions.purpose: Copy Product Line Code from the sales line into the Invoice Posting Buffer.
guards: Subscribe on "Sales Post Invoice Events" (825), not "Sales Post Invoice"

subscriptions.purpose: Add Product Line Code to Group ID so lines with different codes post as separate G/L entries.
guards: Pad the value with PadField as the standard key does
CopyStr to MaxStrLen of Group ID (Text[1000])

subscriptions.purpose: Copy Product Line Code to the Gen. Journal Line.
Copy Product Line Code to the G/L Entry.
guards: Never fill G/L entries after posting by finding and modifying them

subscriptions.purpose: Stop posting a sales order whose Collection Group is blank, before any entry is written and also in posting preview.
guards: Apply only when Document Type = Order (q-check-scope)
Do not check in a page action or in OnAfterPostSalesDoc
Raise an error that tells the user what to fix

lifecycle.step: Set DataClassification on every field added by a tableextension (no table-level value to inherit); choose the value matching the stored data and leave nothing ToBeClassified.
Before release, define the Collection Group and Product Line sources the fields relate to and size every field to the exact related key length (q-lookup-tables).
Decide how existing open sales orders without a Collection Group are handled once the posting check ships (q-existing-orders). No BCQuality article was opened for this step.

tests.given: Customer A (sell-to) with Collection Group X whose Bill-to Customer No. is customer B with Collection Group Y, created with LibrarySales
tests.when: A sales invoice is created for customer A
tests.then: Sales Header Collection Group is Y, not X

tests.given: An item with a Product Line Code, created with LibraryInventory
tests.when: A sales line is created for the item with LibrarySales.CreateSalesLine
tests.then: Sales Line Product Line Code equals the item's code

tests.given: A sales order with two item lines and Collection Group X
tests.when: Collection Group on the header is validated to Y from code
tests.then: Both lines carry Collection Group Y

tests.given: A sales order header with Collection Group X
tests.when: A new item line is added
tests.then: The new line carries Collection Group X (depends on the unresolved line-initialization event)

tests.given: A sales order with Collection Group and lines with Product Line Codes, and a sales return order with the same values
tests.when: Both are posted (ship and invoice; receive and invoice) and the order is archived
tests.then: Shipment, invoice, credit memo, return receipt and archive headers carry Collection Group; their lines carry Collection Group and Product Line Code

tests.given: A sales invoice with two lines on the same G/L account and posting groups but different Product Line Codes
tests.then: Two sales G/L entries exist, each with its own Product Line Code and amount, instead of one merged entry

tests.given: A sales order with a blank Collection Group
tests.when: The order is posted, and separately posting preview is run
tests.then: Both fail with the Collection Group mandatory-field error, verified with Assert.ExpectedTestFieldError (or ExpectedError with the full label text if ErrorInfo is used), and no entries exist

Fill the buffer in OnPrepareLineOnAfterFillInvoicePostingBuffer on "Sales Post Invoice Events", not "Sales Post Invoice"
Add the field to Group ID in OnAfterBuildPrimaryKey with PadField, or lines with different values merge and keep the first line's value
Copy in OnAfterCopyToGenJnlLine and OnAfterCopyGLEntryFromGenJnlLine

Do not check in the page action or after posting in OnAfterPostSalesDoc

knowledge.used-for: Carrying Collection Group and Product Line Code to posted documents and archives.
constraints: Same field number, name, type and length on the source and every target table the plan needs: four posted header tables and the archive, and the line equivalents, unless the plan states a document type never needs it
No subscriber is needed for these stages
Keep mirrored fields non-editable on posted tables

constraints: Mirrored fields must have the exact same field number, data type and length on every table in the cascade, set at creation time

knowledge.used-for: Gen. Journal Line to G/L Entry copy and reversal behavior of Product Line Code.
constraints: Subscribe to the copy event of each entry table the design needs; do not extend VAT or bank entries unless their reports need the value

knowledge.used-for: Choosing between a stored G/L Entry field and a related table.
constraints: Put optional, sparse or integration attributes in a related table keyed by ledger Entry No.
Use a stored tableextension field only when the value must appear as a native list column and is read on almost every access

knowledge.used-for: Sizing Collection Group and Product Line Code fields against their related tables.
constraints: Read the related field's type and length before adding a TableRelation
An unconditional relation requires the same type and exact length as the related field

knowledge.used-for: Data classification of every added field.
constraints: A tableextension field must set its own DataClassification
Choose the value matching the stored data at definition time; do not leave ToBeClassified

knowledge.used-for: Tooltips for the new page fields.
constraints: On runtime 13.0 (BC24) or later define the tooltip on the table field and let bound page fields inherit it; earlier targets need page-level tooltips (applies from BC24)
Tooltip text must say what the value is used for, not just repeat the caption
For a recoverable failure use ErrorInfo with a recommended action only when the solution is genuinely known and the user can apply it
Create customers, items and sales documents with the Library codeunits, parents first, and Validate foreign keys

knowledge.used-for: Negative test for the posting check.
constraints: Follow every asserterror with a check of the specific expected error, e.g. Assert.ExpectedTestFieldError for a mandatory field
Do not rely on ExpectedErrorCode alone or on a fragment shared by other errors

open-questions.question: Are Collection Group and Product Line Code validated against existing tables (which, and what key length) or new setup tables to be created? If new tables are needed, they require their own design (table type, pages, permissions, classification).

The request says the Collection Group defaults on sales invoices, but the bill-to event fires for every sales document type. Should the default apply to all sales documents (orders, quotes, credit memos, return orders) or only invoices?
Must the blank-Collection-Group check apply only to orders, or also to invoices and other posted document types? Should it also block releasing the order (release restriction event)?
When the bill-to customer is changed on a document that already has lines, must the lines take the new customer's Collection Group as well?
The mirroring guidance puts the fields on all posted header/line tables and archives. Are any of shipments, credit memos, return receipts or archives not needed?

Copy Document copies posted and archived documents back with TransferFields, so the old Collection Group would flow into the new document. Is that wanted, or must the value be re-defaulted from the current bill-to customer?

Must Product Line Code appear as a native column on G/L entry lists and be read on almost every access (stored field), or is a related table keyed by Entry No. acceptable? Does Finance also need it on customer ledger, VAT or item ledger entries?
What happens to open orders that exist before the feature is installed and have no Collection Group: backfill from the bill-to customer, or require users to set it?
Which other pages must show the fields (quotes, credit memos, return orders, posted documents, General Ledger Entries)?
Is the feature sales-only, or must purchase documents also split G/L by Product Line Code?
